name: 白秋沙鴨

similarSpecies.distinction: 鵲鴨雄鳥有綠光深色圓頭、喙基圓／橢圓白頰斑及白頸黑背；白秋沙鴨雄鳥則以白色頭身及黑色眼罩為主。此比較使用0055已審閱、物種正確的鵲鴨圖，非換色套用。
紅胸秋沙鴨雄鳥具長而狹的紅喙、深色蓬冠、白領與帶白斑的栗色胸；白秋沙鴨雄鳥體型較小、白頭身配黑眼罩及黑紋。香港紀錄頻率不等同全球IUCN狀態。

rangeMap.note: Full-world partial country overview of the northern Eurasian breeding range and selected European, Central Asian and East Asian wintering areas described by HKBWS. Country highlights are only a subset; green does not mean nationwide occupancy and is not a complete distribution or precise seasonal range polygon. sources.use: Full HKBWS species account read: Hong Kong Category I rare winter visitor, increasingly recorded annually since 2014; 35–44 cm. Female/immature mostly grey with dark rufous crown and hindneck contrasting white throat; adult male breeding is white with black markings including obvious mask; in flight white mantle sides contrast with dark centre and wings. Global IUCN LC, population trend decreasing. Range breeds Scandinavia to western Sea of Okhotsk/Kamchatka/Chukotka and winters in scattered northern/eastern European, Black/Caspian, Kazakhstan, Pakistan and East Asian locations; China winters south to Yangtze floodplain.

HKBWS Common Goldeneye account read: male has a green-glossed dark rounded head with oval white bill-base spot, pale eye, white neck/chest/flanks and dark back; in Hong Kong it is Category I accidental. Used as an explicitly labelled male comparison, not an occurrence-frequency claim.

Full HKBWS Red-breasted Merganser account read: male breeding plumage has dark green head, white collar and mottled brown chest with large white flank spots; long narrow red bill and short sometimes spiky crest; rare winter visitor and passage migrant in Hong Kong, much declined locally since the 1990s; global IUCN LC, stable. Used as an explicitly labelled male comparison; local history and global status are kept distinct.
